T: Bush tucker meets the big smoke.
D: A legendary bushman from the Top End takes on New York.
P: Pour a beer when Mick first sees a bidet in the hotel.
S: Scored belly skin dried overnight, salted hard and roasted until it puffs, cut into shards.
Score pork belly skin, dry uncovered in the fridge overnight, salt heavily, roast at 240C for 30 minutes then 180C for 40 until it puffs and crackles. Cut into shards.
King prawns in garlic, chilli and lemon, grilled hot on skewers over the coals.
King prawns marinated in garlic, chilli, lemon zest and oil, skewered and grilled hot for 90 seconds a side, lemon butter brushed on at the end.
Squid rings in golden breadcrumbs, fried crisp, with lemon wedges and tartare.

Cut 500g cleaned squid tubes into 1cm rings and pat dry. Dust in 75g seasoned plain flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and press into 150g dried breadcrumbs. Heat vegetable oil 4cm deep to 180C and fry in batches for 2 minutes until golden. Drain, salt and serve with lemon wedges and 150g tartare sauce.
M: Crisp-skin barra. Bring a big knife.

Barra fillets, skin scored and grilled crisp, flipped for a minute, brought out with a big knife. Score the skin of 4 barramundi fillets and pat very dry. Grill skin down over high heat until crisp, about 4 minutes, then flip for 1 minute. Melt 80g butter with 2 garlic cloves and a squeeze of lemon and spoon over.
Seared rump on toasted white bread with beetroot, a fried egg and the lot.
Thin rump seared hard, on toasted white bread with caramelised onion, a fried egg, beetroot, tomato, lettuce, cheese and barbecue sauce.
W: Stewed Granny Smiths under a buttery oat crumble, hot custard poured over.

Heat the oven to 180C. Peel, core and slice 6 Granny Smith apples and stew with 60g caster sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 2 tbsp water for 10 minutes. Tip into a baking dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 100g plain flour, then stir in 60g rolled oats and 80g brown sugar and scatter over the apples. Bake 30 minutes until golden and serve hot with 600ml warm custard.
K: Walkabout Creek rum and ginger beer
Dark rum and ginger beer over ice.

Dark rum poured over ice and spicy ginger beer with plenty of fresh lime, in a tall frosty glass. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Squeeze 15ml lime juice into each and add 150ml chilled ginger beer. Slowly pour 45ml dark rum over the back of a spoon so it floats on top. Add a lime wedge and stir at the table.

dishes.make_ahead: Marinate and skewer the prawns up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; grill just before serving

steps.text: Soak the skewers. Toss the prawns with crushed garlic, chopped chilli, zest of one lemon and the oil.
Thread onto skewers and marinate in the fridge.
Grill hot until just cooked, turning once.
Melt the butter with grated lemon zest and brush over. Serve with lemon wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate and skewer the haloumi up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; grill fresh

steps.text: Soak the skewers. Toss the haloumi with crushed garlic, chopped chilli, zest of one lemon and the oil.
Thread onto skewers and marinate in the fridge.
Grill hot until golden on both sides, turning once.
Melt the butter with grated lemon zest and brush over. Serve with lemon wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Crumb the rings up to 4 hours ahead and keep them in the fridge on a tray

steps.text: Cut the squid tubes into 1cm rings and pat dry.
Dust in flour, dip in egg and press into the breadcrumbs.
Heat the oil to 180C and fry the rings in batches until golden.
Drain, salt and serve with lemon wedges and tartare.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb the fingers up to 4 hours ahead and keep them in the fridge

steps.text: Cut the haloumi into thick fingers and pat dry.
Dust in flour, dip in egg and press into the breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot oil until golden, about 2 minutes.
Drain and serve with lemon wedges and tartare.

dishes.make_ahead: Best grilled just before serving; score the skin and pat dry up to 4 hours ahead, uncovered in the fridge

steps.text: Score the skin of the barramundi fillets, pat very dry and brush with the oil.
Grill skin down over high heat for about 4 minutes until crisp, then flip for 1 minute.
Melt the butter with the garlic and a squeeze of lemon, spoon over the fish and serve with the lemons cut into wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Best grilled just before serving; crush the garlic and measure out the butter up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Halve the eggplants lengthways, score the flesh deeply in a criss cross and brush with the oil and salt.
Grill cut side down over medium high heat until charred, then flip and cook until soft right through.
Melt the butter with the garlic and a squeeze of lemon, spoon over the eggplant and serve with the lemons cut into wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Stew the apples and rub the crumble up to 1 day ahead; bake on the night

steps.text: Peel, core and slice the apples.
Stew the apples with the sugar, cinnamon and a splash of water.
Rub the butter into the flour, stir in the oats and brown sugar and scatter over the apples.
Bake at 180C until golden, then serve hot with warm custard.

dishes.n: Walkabout Creek rum and ginger beer
dishes.make_ahead: Best built to order; squeeze the lime juice up to 1 day ahead and keep the ginger beer chilled

steps.text: Fill tall glasses with ice and add lime juice to each.
Add the ginger beer to each glass.
Slowly pour the rum over the back of a spoon so it floats on top.
Add a lime wedge and stir at the table.

af.make_ahead: Brew, sweeten and chill the dark tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; build the glasses to order

steps.text: Brew the tea bag in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove it, stir in the molasses and vanilla and chill.
Fill tall glasses with ice and add lime juice to each.
Add the ginger beer to each glass.
Slowly pour the dark tea over the back of a spoon so it floats on top.
Add a lime wedge and stir at the table.
